question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column ‘A’ ‘B’ and ‘C’ to write five complete sentences. 1  5 =
stimulus: Column 'A' Column 'B' Column 'C' (a) Facebook is an internet i. internet connection may i. gain access to Facebook. (b) Nowadays, Facebook has ii. using Facebook ii. among people living anywhere. become iii. based social network iii. to facilitate the official works. (c) It contributes much iv. to maintain social and iv. connecting people worldwide. (d) People are also friendly relationship v. of our daily life. (e) Everybody having v. an important part
guide_solution: (a) Facebook is an internet-based social network connecting people worldwide. (b) Nowadays, Facebook has become an important part of our daily life. (c) It contributes much to maintain social and friendly relationship among people living anywhere. (d) People are also using Facebook to facilitate the official works. (e) Everybody having internet connection may gain access to Facebook.
